memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system source store, creating ANY new script under agent-system/extensions/<ext>/scripts/ (including a test suite) owes an entry in that extension's manifest.json provides.scripts -- an explicit, non-glob list (409 entries for core) whose completeness is enforced by check-extension-docs.sh Rule Q inside verify-deploy.sh gate 3, which is commit-blocking. run-all.sh discovers suites by glob and needs no entry, so authors reasonably expect provides.scripts to behave like index-entries.json's wholesale-directory convention; it does not, and a missing entry produces no authoring-time signal. Remedy is one command: sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write (then --check). A plan that creates a new source-store script must declare manifest.json in the SAME phase per plan-format.md's coupled-generated-surface obligation.
